sourceFile: 06.MSU-20S15-07 Result test CD from New vendor GES - 2025.04.28_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the GES vs RALON vendor comparison but has incorrect condition grouping, line pairing, and a spurious measurement outcome.
issues: Changed condition wrongly includes Dyne and VP+CD separate as factors.
Function results do not preserve line grouping; C2 test is paired with the wrong normal row.
Subgroup keys should include line/date for E2-4B and C2 comparisons.
Header/function row statistics create an invalid measurement outcome.
Tension outcome lacks judged paired comparison by line and spec/result context.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to vendor/source CD: Normal RALON vs Test GES.
Use Dyne, VP+CD separate, function, and tension only as outcomes.
Pair function rows by line: E2-4B test vs normal and C2 test vs normal.
Rebuild tension comparisons by line with pass/NG, spec, min, max, avg, and sample count noted.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are mostly sufficient, but corrected outcomes must cite the exact paired data rows and avoid header-only rows.
